from f145 import order_by_points


def test_order_by_points_positive_numbers():
    assert order_by_points([11, 22, 3]) == [11, 22, 3]


def test_order_by_points_negative_numbers_use_negative_sign():
    # (-13) -> -1 + 3 = 2 ; (-4) -> -4 ; (7) -> 7
    assert order_by_points([7, -4, -13]) == [-4, -13, 7]


def test_order_by_points_mixed_signs_both_branches():
    # 10 -> 1 ; -10 -> -1 ; 5 -> 5 ; -6 -> -6
    assert order_by_points([10, -10, -6, 5]) == [-6, -10, 10, 5]


def test_order_by_points_zero():
    assert order_by_points([0, -0]) == [0, -0]


def test_order_by_points_does_not_mutate_input():

    original = list(nums)
    order_by_points(nums)
    assert nums == original


def test_order_by_points_empty():
